titleEn: MooMonitor 360 launched to enhance the evolution of herd intelligence
titleZh: Dairymaster推出MooMonitor 360，提升牛群智能化管理水平
summaryZh: Dairymaster发布新一代MooMonitor 360健康与繁殖监测系统，基于DairyVue 360软件构建统一互联平台，整合牛群活动、健康、繁殖、挤奶性能和分群信息，提供智能分析和优化输精图表，帮助奶农从单纯监测转向深度理解牛群，提升繁殖效率和管理决策水平。
featuredReason: 该新闻展示了牧场管理从单一监测向统一智能平台演进的最新趋势，DairyVue 360软件整合多源数据并提供繁殖优化建议，对智慧畜牧从业者了解奶牛场数字化管理前沿具有重要参考价值。
contentFull: Top Stories Beef Dairy Sheep Tillage Machinery Northern Ireland Videos Podcasts Ploughing 2026 Top Stories Beef Dairy Sheep Tillage Machinery Northern Ireland Videos Podcasts Ploughing 2026 Ploughing 2026 Visitors Guide Sponsored MooMonitor 360 launched to enhance the evolution of herd intelligence ![Image 1: Agriland Team By Agriland Team September 13, 2026 5:00 AM](https:www.agriland.iefarming-newsauthoragriland-team) Share this article ![Image 2](https:www.agriland.iefarming-newsmoomonitor-360-launched-to-enhance-the-evolution-of-herd-intelligence) Sponsored by !Image 3 Dairymaster today announced the launch of the new MooMonitor 360, the next generation of its industry-leading health and fertility monitoring system. Built on years of trusted performance, MooMonitor 360 introduces a more intelligent, connected approach to herd management, helping farmers move beyond monitoring to understanding their herd like never before. For years, the MooMonitor system has helped dairy farmers improve fertility performance through accurate activity monitoring and industry-leading heat detection. The launch comes as dairy farms make greater use of automation, software and connected technologies while also managing labour pressures and larger, increasingly complex herds. This has increased both the volume of information available to farmers and the need to turn that information into practical insights. MooMonitor 360 Today, herd management requires more than monitoring alone. MooMonitor 360 has been developed to meet that need. At the heart of MooMonitor 360 is a single connected platform that brings together herd activity, health, fertility, milking performance, drafting information and much more into one complete view of the herd. The platform features a redesigned user experience with a new dashboard, enhanced reporting and intelligent analytics powered by the new DairyVue 360 software. ![Image 4](https:images.agriland.ie53u1WKTX-3LZrL5RwMLy2aJtwYijQH-pMKxIvALprsrs:fit:1024:0bg:FFFFFFplainhttps:cdn.agriland.ieuploads202609dairymaster-launches-new-moomonitor-360-scaled.jpg) Rather than switching between different systems, farmers can access the information they need in one place, allowing them to identify trends faster, prioritise cows requiring attention and make more informed management decisions. For fertility management, MooMonitor 360 provides deeper visibility of key reproductive performance indicators, including submission rates, conception rates and pregnancy performance. Farmers can track fertility progress over time, identify opportunities for improvement and gain a clearer understanding of herd reproductive performance. Optimal insemination graphing provides an additional layer of insight, helping farmers identify the best opportunities for insemination and support more informed breeding decisions. "Modern dairy farming generates more information than ever before, but information alone isn't enough. "MooMonitor 360 brings together herd activity, fertility, health, milking and drafting information into one connected platform, giving farmers a complete understanding of herd performance and the confidence to make better decisions every day. "We are delighted to be launching this new product at this year’s National Ploughing Championships," CEO of Dairymaster, John Harty said. The launch reflects Dairymaster's continued commitment to developing technologies that simplify herd management while improving productivity, efficiency and profitability. For more information about MooMonitor 360, be the first to see it at the Dairymaster stand at the National Ploughing Championships at Block 3, Row 6, Stand 126. translationZh:
Dairymaster今日宣布推出全新MooMonitor 360，这是其行业领先的健康与繁殖监测系统的下一代产品。MooMonitor 360基于多年值得信赖的性能表现，引入了更智能、更互联的牛群管理方式，帮助养殖户超越监测层面，以前所未有的方式理解自己的牛群。

多年来，MooMonitor系统通过精准的活动监测和行业领先的发情检测，帮助奶农提升繁殖性能。此次发布正值奶牛场越来越多地采用自动化、软件和互联技术，同时应对劳动力压力和更大、更复杂的牛群。这既增加了养殖户可获取的信息量，也增加了将这些信息转化为实用洞察的需求。

**MooMonitor 360**

如今，牛群管理需要的不仅仅是监测。MooMonitor 360正是为满足这一需求而开发的。MooMonitor 360的核心是一个单一互联平台，将牛群活动、健康、繁殖、挤奶性能、分群信息等整合为一个完整的牛群视图。该平台采用重新设计的用户体验，配备全新仪表盘、增强报告功能和由全新DairyVue 360软件驱动的智能分析。

养殖户无需在不同系统之间切换，即可在一个平台上获取所需信息，从而更快识别趋势、优先处理需要关注的奶牛，并做出更明智的管理决策。

在繁殖管理方面，MooMonitor 360提供关键繁殖性能指标的更深入可视化，包括参配率、受胎率和妊娠表现。养殖户可以跟踪繁殖进展随时间的变化，识别改进机会，并更清晰地了解牛群繁殖性能。最佳输精时间图表提供了额外的洞察层，帮助养殖户识别最佳输精时机，支持更明智的育种决策。

“现代奶牛养殖产生的信息比以往任何时候都多，但仅有信息是不够的。MooMonitor 360将牛群活动、繁殖、健康、挤奶和分群信息整合到一个互联平台中，让养殖户全面了解牛群表现，并有信心每天做出更好的决策。我们很高兴在今年全国耕作锦标赛上推出这款新产品，”Dairymaster首席执行官John Harty表示。

此次发布体现了Dairymaster持续致力于开发简化牛群管理、同时提高生产力、效率和盈利能力的技术的承诺。

如需了解MooMonitor 360的更多信息，请在全国耕作锦标赛Dairymaster展台（第3区第6排126号展位）率先体验。在此了解新功能。
